items: Row magnets: each timeline row has its own magnet button at the left. On = cut, shorten, lengthen, slow or delete a clip and the rest of that row follows
Space plays the video after you click the timeline or the video, even if you were typing to Claude
Claude's steps (Adjusting...) are tucked behind a small arrow; click to see the list
Speed: a slider with minus and plus buttons, quick speeds, and the clip's new length
Changing a clip's speed now moves the clips, texts and sounds after it along, instead of sliding under the next clip
Claude's replies are clean to read: real headings, bold words and bullet lists, no # or * symbols
The editor now looks at GitHub for updates every 2 hours instead of every 10 minutes
Setup is safer on a new PC: it checks the folder path is short enough and installs exactly the tested packages
Updates from GitHub: the editor tells you when a newer version has been pushed, and Get update installs it
The 😂 and ❤️ endings work without any picture files (drawn from Windows' emoji font if assets\emoji is empty)
Media panel rebuilt like CapCut's: kinds on the left (All, Videos, Pictures, Sounds, Added, Not used), Import, Record and search on top, and an Added badge on files already in the timeline
The editor now fits small laptops (icons-only category bar) and phone-width windows (one column: video, then Add or Settings, then the timeline)
Typing in a text no longer hangs: the box keeps up with the keyboard and the preview catches up when you pause
Follow the speaker: a line of dialogue can now stay under a moving speaker's mouth (Options tab or right-click), using position keyframes
Live link: when you ask Claude in a chat to change a video, it changes in this open window straight away, no reload
A project moved to the trash folder now leaves the Projects list
Loading feedback: Open in CapCut shows each step and tells you when CapCut is really open; asking Claude for options shows a spinner, a seconds count and placeholders
Slow actions (freeze, ending, follow the head) say what they are doing; buttons dip when pressed; menus grow out of their button
The other wordings Claude offers for a text are now saved inside the project
Hover preview: move the mouse over the timeline to see that moment, with a faint line (the eye button turns it off)
Colours work like My Animator: pick an accent and a base; the colour you pick is used exactly
New Audio tab: search, listen before adding, and a list of the sounds in this video with volume and mute
More effects (zoom punch, slow zoom, shake, glitch, blur, looks) and six transitions for cuts
Open in CapCut now carries pop-ups, follow tags, the growing emoji, text colours, mirror, volume, colour split, blur shake and the Glare transition
Import from CapCut (Projects page): bring a CapCut project in as a new project
Select several clips (Ctrl+click or drag a box) and change their shared settings together: size, scale, position, style, volume
Text clips on the timeline are orange
Two more timeline buttons: Crop (a box on the clip) and Record voice (microphone)
Video clips on the timeline have CapCut's three bands: details on top, pictures, and a sound band where you drag the volume line
Timeline toolbar in CapCut's order: undo, redo, split, delete left, delete right, delete, marker, freeze, mirror
New layout: CapCut tall preview (the preview runs down the whole right side)
Preview zoom bar: minus, slider, plus
Texts in older projects are resized once to your standard (font size 12, scale 120%) when you open them
Layout button (top right): six ready-made layouts, including CapCut style and Big preview
Timeline clips now show their speed and length, and you drag the line on a clip to change its volume
Right-click a text for what to use on that part, including other wordings from Claude
Text settings look like CapCut's: font size 12 and scale 120% are your standard, with preset styles
Video settings look like CapCut's: Video, Audio, Speed tabs with Scale, Position, Rotate and Blend
The app's own text is now Poppins
Sound: clips keep their own sound now (they were muted when cut by the AI)
Timeline pictures show what is inside each clip, not the start of the video
AI is now a tab next to Media instead of a floating box
Select a text to get quick options: place, ▼, pop-up, follow the head, fit to its scene, flash or freeze here
Projects button (top left): open any project or start a new empty one
Update popup: when a new version is made, it shows here and is one click away
Open in CapCut now really opens: the project is written in CapCut's full layout, with corrected text size
Text clips on the timeline are now coloured along their whole length
Clearer look: easier-to-read small text, real icons on the effect buttons, tips on every category, softer panel colours you can tint
The AI now follows a script exactly when you give it one: your words, your order, your notes
Claude chat (AI button), auto-follow tags, freeze, endings, effects, captions and tags panels
